activity_summary: With the door shut and the boys gone, Cuthbert told the hearsay again and Bryan made him separate the letter from the clerk. James had eighty-four and two years on the ground, and did not march. Heminges said a letter asking is not an order granted, and that the reckoning is thirty-three shillings a share. Kemp said tour. The room did not agree to tour. You said the Mayor writes of June and a king is to be put down, and that my lord should hear it from you before the board. Heminges sends to Kettleby tonight. Monday is as billed. There is to be no talk of it at the Jackdaw.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said little, then said my lord should hear it from them before the board, and left the coffer shut.

entities.name: Cuthbert Burbage
entities.context: Told it again, and kept the Theatre unswearable by name.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Went purple over eighty-four, and did not march on Crosby Place.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Called a letter asking short of an order, named thirty-three shillings, and took the sending to Kettleby.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Said tour, and did not get it agreed.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept Thursday fortnight, and said he would play the king in the street if they are shut on the first of October.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Separated the letter's words from the clerk's, and gave a mayor six weeks in the chain.

entities.name: Ambrose Kettleby
entities.context: Not in the room. Heminges sends to him tonight.

entities.name: thirty-three shillings
entities.context: Mentioned in A letter asking is not an order

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: Eighty-four! Fleetwood sent for me in 'eighty-four

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Item. A letter asking is not an order granted.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: If they shut us on the first of October I'll play him in the street.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Cut or no, I would have my lord hear of this from us before he hears it at the board.
